trans-unit.source: What is the difference between the two lines in a graph?

For val_..., the metric is calculated on the validation data set while for the data without val as a prefix the metric is calculated on the training data set. The metrics for the validation data set can be seen as more meaningful since this is the data the network does not 'know'.

trans-unit.source: A dense layer, also called fully-connected layer, is a layer whose inside neurons connect to every neuron in the preceding layer.

trans-unit.source: An input layer is a layer that just takes data provided from outside the network and passes it on to the next layer(s)

trans-unit.source: An output layer in this simulation is just a normal dense layer, additionally equipped with the ability to output the incoming data out of the network.
trans-unit.target: Tabaka la tokeo katika uigaji huu ni tabaka la kawaida lenye miunganisho kamili ambalo pia linaweza kutoa nje ya mtandao data inayoingia.

trans-unit.source: Since the purpose if this layer is to output a classifiction, we should combine it with a softmax activation function in order to provide a probability distribution.
trans-unit.target: Kwa kuwa tabaka hili linatoa matokeo ya uainishaji, tumia kikokotoo cha uamilishaji softmax ili kupata mgawanyo wa uwezekano.

trans-unit.source: The Pima Indians Diabetes data set involves predicting the onset of diabetes within 5 years in Pima Indians given medical details. It is a binary (2-class) classification problem. The number of observations for each class is not balanced. There are 768 observations with 8 input variables and 1 output variable. Missing values are believed to be encoded with zero values.
trans-unit.target: Seti hii ya data hutumiwa kutabiri kuanza kwa kisukari ndani ya miaka mitano kwa watu wa Pima kwa kutumia taarifa za kitabibu. Ni tatizo la uainishaji wa makundi mawili. Idadi ya sampuli katika kila kundi haitoshi kwa uwiano sawa. Kuna sampuli 768 zenye vigezo 8 vya pembejeo na kigezo 1 cha tokeo. Thamani zinazokosekana huenda ziliwakilishwa kwa sifuri.

trans-unit.source: Why are some important options not editable or completely missing?
trans-unit.target: Kwa nini chaguo fulani muhimu haziwezi kuhaririwa au hazionekani kabisa?

trans-unit.source: Many options are uneditable after you started a training to make sure what you see is actually what got translated into the model. To be able to edit everything again, just use the option to reset the model. After you performed your desired changes, you can then train a new model that respects them. If there is no trained model and you are missing options, most likely your teacher has disabled them for you.
trans-unit.target: Chaguo nyingi hufungwa baada ya kuanza mafunzo ili kinachoonekana kilingane na usanidi wa modeli. Ili kuhariri tena, weka modeli upya. Baada ya mabadiliko, unaweza kufundisha modeli mpya inayotumia usanidi mpya. Ikiwa hakuna modeli iliyofundishwa na chaguo hazionekani, huenda mwalimu wako amezizima.
